title: [CON2-13] Conformance classes cite the wrong sections, or too few, for the new services
description: Review finding CON2-13: Conformance classes cite the wrong sections, or too few, for the new services (lens CON2). Location: spec/01-overview.md:84, :90, :91. Fix: Space endpoint row already lists §3.4 first, so the problem is only the mislabeled parenthetical: change "§5.2.1.4 (`ChannelAdmissionKey` and `BroadcastKey` service)" to "§5.2.1.4 (broadcast key policy)" or drop it. For Sequencer and SFU, §14.4.3 step 3 and §6.6 join check already place the admission obligations themselves (citing §10.5.3/§10.5.4); what is genuinely unbound is registration intake and agreement lifecycle. Use the Relay row's form: "§14.4 and the sections it cites" / "§6.6, §6.9, §6.10 and the sections they cite", or add "§10.5.1, §10.5.3" explicitly (§10.5.4 is reached through the citations). Full text: notes/review2/CON2-verified.md and notes/review2/CON2.md.
